'''Nicole Fujita''' (Japanese: '''藤田ニコル''' ''Fujita Nikoru'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Fujita was born on February 20, 1998 in {{wp|Milford}}, {{wp|Auckland}}, {{wp|New Zealand}}, and is a Japanese model and {{wp|tarento}}. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she gained several roles including including {{DL|Pikala|Curly|Pikala's Curly}} and {{p|Stufful}}.
